Suprajit Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Postal Ballot
voiceSummary: Suprajit Engineering Limited has issued a notice for a postal ballot seeking shareholder approval for the appointment of Dr. Steffen Berns, DIN 06449396, as a Non-Executive Independent Director. The resolution is subject to member approval via remote e-voting. The voting period begins on November 23, 2026, at 09.00 A.M. IST and ends on December 22, 2026, at 5.00 P.M. IST. The cut-off date for eligibility is November 20, 2026. If approved, the appointment will take effect from January 1, 2027, for a term of three years until December 31, 2029. Mr. Parameshwar G. Bhat has been appointed as the scrutinizer for the process. The scrutinizer’s report and the final voting results are scheduled to be announced on or before December 24, 2026.

attchmntText: Newspaper publication regarding Postal Ballot Notice.
voiceSummary: Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited published a Postal Ballot Notice on November 21, 2026, in the Financial Express and Vishwavani newspapers. attchmntText: QMS Medical Allied Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: QMS Medical Allied Services Limited filed the transcript of its earnings call for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, held on November 17, 2026. For Q2 FY 27, revenue from operations increased by 17.5% year-on-year to INR52.5 crores. For H1 FY 27, revenue grew by 20% to INR109.4 crores. EBITDA for Q2 stood at INR6.5 crores with a margin of 12.4%. H1 EBITDA increased by 11% to INR14.8 crores. PAT for Q2 was INR2.4 crores, while H1 PAT was INR6.4 crores. The company announced the acquisition of the remaining 24% stake in Saarathi Healthcare in September 2026. A composite scheme of arrangements to merge HCAH patient support programs with Saarathi Healthcare was approved by the Boards on September 25, 2026, subject to regulatory approvals. An exclusive agreement with HEINE Opto for diagnostic instruments was signed, commencing January 1, 2027. A binding MOU to acquire 100% of BeamOptics Scientific was also signed on September 25, 2026.

attchmntText: Cohance Lifesciences Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Cohance Lifesciences Limited, symbol COHANCE, code 543064, has updated the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited regarding the USFDA inspection of its formulation facility in Shamshabad, Telangana. The facility's FEI number is 3019037664. The United States Food and Drug Administration has issued the Establishment Inspection Report for this facility. The inspection outcome is classified as Voluntary Action Indicated. This update follows the company's earlier communication dated 5 September 2026. attchmntText: Bajaj Consumer Care Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ' Order passed by the Office of the Deputy Commissioner of State Tax Jurisdiction: Udaipur, Rajasthan'.
voiceSummary: Bajaj Consumer Care Limited disclosed an order dated 20 November 2026 from the Deputy Commercial Tax Officer, Udaipur. The order demands tax of Rs. 17,23,895 for ineligible Input Tax Credit claimed under RGST, CGST, and IGST Acts. A penalty of Rs. 2,42,390 and interest of Rs. 9,60,657 were also levied. The company states there is no impact on its financial, operational, or other activities. The order is appealable, and the company is contesting it at a higher appellate level.

attchmntText: Shalimar Paints Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 21, 2026, titled "From first pour to final coat: Shalimar Paints to become an integrated building materials company".
voiceSummary: Shalimar Paints Limited issued a press release on 21 November 2026 outlining the proposed merger with Infra.Market Limited. The transaction remains subject to approvals from stock exchanges, SEBI, the National Company Law Tribunal, and creditors. On a pro forma basis for FY26, the combined entity would record revenue of 19,839 crore and EBITDA of 1,709 crore. The merged company would operate 250 plus manufacturing plants and serve 20,000 plus retail touchpoints. Post-merger shareholding would include the founders and promoter group holding 30.6 percent, Tiger Global holding 20.8 percent, and Accel holding 15.2 percent. Existing public shareholders would hold 0.7 percent. The company stated it is transforming into an integrated building materials platform.

attchmntText: Shalimar Paints Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 51948051 securities pursuant to Qualified Institution Placement at its meeting held on November 20, 2026
voiceSummary: Shalimar Paints Limited has allotted 5,19,48,051 equity shares at Rs. 77 per share, aggregating to Rs. 3,99,99,99,927. This Qualified Institutions Placement closed on November 20, 2026. The issue price represents a discount of approximately 4.785% to the floor price of Rs. 80.87. The company's paid-up equity share capital increases from 8,37,11,178 shares to 13,56,59,229 shares. Previous approvals were granted by the Board on August 12, 2026, and by shareholders on September 11, 2026.

attchmntText: SRF Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) taken or orders passed
voiceSummary: SRF Limited disclosed receipt of an Order-in-Original from the Office of the Commissioner of Customs, NS II – Nhava Sheva Port on 20.11.2026 at 09.11 a.m. The Customs Authority imposed a redemption fine of Rs. 15 lakh under Section 125 of the Customs Act, 1962, and a penalty of Rs. 7 lakh under Section 114(iii) of the Customs Act, 1962. The order rejects RoDTEP benefits claimed by the company on certain export products totaling Rs. 17,01,701. The authority considered these products ineligible because the requisite Export Authorisation or NOC was not established for the relevant consignments. SRF Limited states it intends to contest the order before the appropriate appellate or legal forum. The company asserts the order is not legally sustainable and believes there is no material impact on its operations or other activities.

attchmntText: Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Postal Ballot
voiceSummary: Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited has issued a notice for a postal ballot to seek shareholder approval on five special resolutions. attchmntText: Indusind Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: IndusInd Bank Limited disclosed that its Board of Directors, meeting on November 20, 2026, decided to terminate the employment of former Managing Director and CEO Sumant Kathpalia with immediate effect. This decision follows an Enquiry Officer report dated November 18, 2026. The Board also invoked applicable malus and claw-back provisions effective from Mr. Kathpalia's initial appointment date of March 24, 2020. Mr. Kathpalia had resigned on April 29, 2025, and was suspended on June 18, 2025, pending disciplinary proceedings. The Board meeting commenced at 5:31 p.m. IST and concluded at 7:50 p.m. IST.

attchmntText: Shalimar Paints Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of QIP Committee Meeting held on November 20, 2026.
voiceSummary: Shalimar Paints Limited has closed its Qualified Institutions Placement. attchmntText: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited has informed the Exchange about disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
sm_name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
voiceSummary: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited received an order from the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India dated November 20, 2026. The order levies a penalty of Rs. 2,00,00,000 under IRDAI Health Insurance Regulations, 2016. The penalty relates to aspects of claim settlement identified during an inspection conducted between 31 January and 11 February 2022. The financial impact is restricted to the penalty amount. No impact is expected on operations or other activities. The company is evaluating options to address the matter. The disclosure was submitted to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.
